Page 682 
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of advanced renal cell carcinoma (RCC)  
 
AND 
 
2 - ONE of the following:  
• 
Disease has relapsed  
• 
Disease is refractory  
 
AND 
 
3 - Patient has received two or more prior systemic therapies
